2607.26015.title: Instruction-Tuned Models Locally Reuse Human Syntax More Than Humans Do
2607.26015.paper_summary: Syntactic convergence (the tendency of speakers to adapt in language towards the grammatical profiles of their interlocutors) is a well-documented feature of human dialogue widely considered to operate below conscious awareness. Whether large language models exhibit analogous syntactic convergence toward human users relative to human baselines and across a broad range of syntactic constructions remains an open question. Using substitution-paradigm data in which model generations replace one speaker's turns in pre-existing human dialogues, this study measures turn-adjacent reuse of context-free grammar (CFG) rules across sixteen open-weight Llama and Gemma models (1B-70B, pretrained and instruction-tuned) at 1,901 matched positions per model. Every model showed greater CFG-rule overlap with the preceding human turn than with a sampled unrelated human prime, and in every model this actual-versus-random difference was larger for lower-frequency rules. Each instruction-tuned model also showed greater natural-output overlap with the actual prime than the human response it replaced, and all eight matched architecture pairs exhibited greater actual-prime overlap after instruction tuning. However, relative to pretrained variants, instruction-tuned outputs overlapped more with unrelated primes, showed a smaller actual-versus-random increment, and had lower conditional rule-reuse odds once target rule-set size was held constant. In exploratory analyses, each model exhibited greater mean lexical and semantic similarity to the preceding turn than the matched human responses did. Instruction-tuned models additionally produced responses with greater mean semantic similarity than their pretrained counterparts in all eight architecture pairs, whereas the lexical similarity results were more heterogeneous.
2607.26015.paper_summary_zh: 句法收斂（講者在語言上適應其對話者的語法特徵的傾向）是人類對話中一個記錄良好的特徵，廣泛認為其運作在意識之下。大型語言模型是否相對於人類基準和廣泛的句法結構，展示類似的人類語法收斂，仍然是一個未解的問題。這項研究使用替代範式數據，其中模型生成替換了預先存在的人類對話中的一位講者的發言，測量了十六個開放權重的Llama和Gemma模型（1B-70B，預訓練和指令調整）在每個模型的1,901個匹配位置上，與上下文無關的文法（CFG）規則的相鄰重用。每個模型顯示出與前一個人類發言的CFG規則重疊程度高於與隨機選取的無關人類提示，並且在每個模型中，這種實際與隨機的差異對於低頻規則來說更大。每個指令調整的模型還顯示出與實際提示的自然輸出重疊程度高於其所替代的人類回應，所有八對匹配的架構在指令調整後都顯示出更大的實際提示重疊。然而，相對於預訓練變體，指令調整的輸出與無關提示的重疊更多，實際與隨機的增量較小，並且在目標規則集大小保持不變的情況下，其條件規則重用的機率較低。在探索性分析中，每個模型顯示出與前一個發言的平均詞彙和語義相似度高於匹配的人類回應。指令調整的模型在所有八對架構中產生的回應具有比其預訓練對應物更高的平均語義相似度，而詞彙相似度的結果則更為異質。
2607.26015.author: Zandi Eberstadt et.al.
